answer: Wildlife agents track a falcon overhead and a sable that may wander across camera zones. To prevent a swarm of aliases taking every research grant, the fund issues one nontransferable operator credential after an in-person uniqueness check. Each grant round accepts one credential-derived nullifier, rejecting repeats even from new agent accounts. One operator can run many agents, but cannot multiply grant entries. This relies on honest issuers and secure credentials, not on names being unique.
